persons.name: Uddhavarāja
persons.evidence: śrī upādhyā uddhavarājena sañcitam idaṃ pustakaṃ

date.as_written: saṃvat 746 caitra śukla navamyāntithau puṣyanakṣatre ādityavāsare

notes: Two dates are given: first, NS 731 kārttika kṛṣṇa 3 budhavāra (Rohiṇī nakṣatra), recording when the Guhyakālīpratiṣṭhā was performed and the book was collected/acquired by Upādhyāya Uddhavarāja (with a pratiṣṭhā at Caparitale); second, NS 746 caitra śukla 9 ādityavāsare (Puṣya nakṣatra), the date of copying by Kālīdāsa. Guru Uddhavanātha and Upādhyāya Uddhavarāja may be the same person.
